about_short_description.short_description: all-in-one tool for AI video production

product.name: Video Composer
product.description: An AI-driven tool that generates complete videos from simple text instructions, including visuals, voiceovers, music, and sound effects.

product.name: AI Native Video Editor
product.description: A video editing interface that allows users to generate and fine-tune video clips, voiceovers, and sound effects with AI assistance.

product.name: AI Sound
product.description: An AI system that generates synchronized voiceovers, sound effects, and music for videos.

product.name: Character Studio
product.description: An AI-powered platform for creating and customizing unique video characters in various styles.

product.name: AIV Consistent Video
product.description: A reference-based AI video generation model that maintains visual consistency across characters, styles, and scenes.

product.name: Flux Kontext
product.description: A multimodal AI image generator and editor that combines text prompts with image references for context-aware visual creation and editing.
